name: flattenLinkedList
description: Traverse the list; when a node with a child is found, insert the child's sublist between the current node and its next. Uses a stack or recursive DFS to handle multiple levels.
aim: Flatten a multilevel doubly linked list where each node may have a child pointer to another linked list. Convert to a single-level linked list by inserting child lists after their parent nodes.
howItWorks: Traverse the list node by node
When a node has a child: find the tail of the child list
Connect child's tail → current's original next
Continue traversal — child nodes are now inline

realWorld: File system directory flattening: convert tree to flat file list
UI component trees: flatten nested menu/tree structures
OS process trees: flatten parent-child process hierarchy
whenToUse: Converting nested linked structures to flat lists
